visualDirection: Near-black background with a disciplined gold accent. One centered line per shot, generous negative space, and the built-in glow and rings standing in for light on glass. Copy grows calmer and larger toward the end.

criteria: "Nocturne" is fully visible and legible from frame 18 to the end of the shot.
The whole line sits inside the safe area on every frame.
"After dark" and the gold accent are visible on the last frame.

creativeCriteria: Every line of copy has at least 4.5:1 contrast with the background.
The gold accent appears in every shot and nowhere else competes with the copy.
